# Finish the album
Done when (verifiable): Ten mastered tracks are uploaded to the distributor.

## The scene (desired)
I play back the final mix in a quiet studio and it sounds like I meant it.

## True now (reported)
Seven of ten songs drafted; none mixed.

## Obstacle and plan (planned)
- Obstacle: I open a new idea instead of finishing the current song. · Gap class: process
- If I open a new idea instead of finishing the current song, then I write the idea in the idea log and return to the current song for 20 minutes.

## Bridge
- Skills to grow: Mixing low end; Deciding when a song is finished
- Systems to build: Design: a one-page finishing spec per song; Automate: a weekly mix-review with an agent that compares versions
- Reps:
  - 3× per week — 90-minute finishing session
- Bold moves:
  - Book the mastering engineer (done 2026-10-02)
  - Host a listening evening for twelve people (planned, due 2026-11-13)
- People and places:
  - person: A mastering engineer who works with acoustic records — I cannot hear my own low end honestly yet. (wish)
  - place: A living room with twelve chairs — The songs need to be heard by people, not by algorithms first. (reached)

## Is it enough? (computed 2026-10-04)
On pace: 5 of 6 planned reps in the last 14 days, no overdue moves.
- Keep the rep the same size. Consistency beats intensity.
